findings.summary: Worker Docker ignore rules re-include ignored artifacts and potential package-local environment files, while the validator rejects safe nested exclusions.
The canonical combined coverage report enumerates health.ts only even though isolated coverage proves the omitted modules are fully covered.

passing_evidence.isolated_module_coverage: 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines for startup-config.ts and oci-contract.ts; health.ts exceeds 80%
passing_evidence.container_runtime: live/readiness 200, invalid env exit 1, SIGTERM exit 0

blocking_evidence.proof: A scratch image COPY of services/worker/.turbo/turbo-lint.log succeeded under the checked-in Dockerfile.dockerignore.
blocking_evidence.required_action: Exclude nested node_modules, dist, .turbo, coverage, .env, and .env.* paths; enforce them in validator/tests; rebuild and re-review.
